corrections.reason: Value, cluster and couplings verified; the journal prints the same digits. The footnote that names H. Fehske's unpublished ED ('12 phonons, 3.0 × 10^7 basis states') is Ref. 28 in the journal (Ref. 26 there is Trugman in Plenum Press), Ref. [26] only in arXiv v1; the journal reference wins (RULES.md 8). Boundary: Bonča et al. state that finite-N ED energies are for chains 'with periodic boundary conditions' and the ED basis is 'symmetrized'; the basis size matches one electron on 16 sites with total phonon number ≤ 12 (C(28,12) = 30,421,755), so the truncation is in the total phonon number. bound_type variational (truncated ED) agrees.
